conclusion: Confirmed systemic class: 4 live, read-only MCP tools -- read_chapter, search_classical_texts, list_classical_texts, find_verses_about -- are 100% unreachable for any argument. All four are registered in the same file (read_classical_text.ts), share the identical root cause (MCP-facing name never added as a key to MCP_TO_RETRIEVAL_TOOL), and fail with the identical error shape. No further whitelist-class dead tools were found among the two calling conventions that route through the gated /api/mcp/primitives/[tool] endpoint.
